reason: B offers the cleaner, more directly testable dual-phase mechanism: controlled variation of FCC/BCC interface spacing with creep rate and dislocation accumulation as decisive outcomes. A is weakened by claiming that dynamic-recrystallization grain refinement improves creep resistance even though its cited evidence indicates refinement can accelerate creep through grain-boundary sliding, and its precipitation-suppression comparison introduces major processing or compositional confounders.
